Package neqsim.process.equipment.distillation

Class SarirAtmosphericPumparoundScreen

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.distillation.SarirAtmosphericPumparoundScreen
public final class SarirAtmosphericPumparoundScreen extends Object
Source-bounded pump-around screening for a SarirAtmosphericFractionationCase.

The Sarir source publishes pump-around labels, raw tray numbers, circulation rates, and draw and return temperatures, but it does not state the direction used to number trays. This class therefore requires explicit bottom-up NeqSim tray indices and liquid draw fractions from the caller. Published rates and temperatures are retained as comparison evidence and are not used as hidden calibration targets.

  • Method Details

    • configure

      public static SarirAtmosphericPumparoundScreen configure(SarirAtmosphericFractionationCase fractionationCase, int maxIterations, double relativeTolerance, SarirAtmosphericPumparoundScreen.Mapping... mappings)
      Configure one or both published Sarir pump-around circuits on an unsolved case.
      Parameters:
      fractionationCase - unsolved qualified Sarir atmospheric-fractionation case
      maxIterations - positive pump-around outer-iteration budget
      relativeTolerance - positive finite pump-around return-flow tolerance
      mappings - explicit source-row-to-NeqSim mappings
      Returns:
      configured screen
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if the case or mappings array is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if a mapping set is empty, duplicated, or invalid
      IllegalStateException - if the column was already solved or already has a pump-around
